data.name: Yatim 21In Light Green Artificial Hydrangea Flowers with Stems 5 Pcs | Real Touch Hydrangeas, Full Latex Petals, for Home DIY Floral Arrangements Wedding Outdoor Decor
data.description:
Material: Faux Hydrangea Flower are made of high quality of 3D Print Latex Flowers and the metal wire wrapped in plastic is used to fix and adjust the angle to make artificial flower stalks. Lifelike hydrangea made of hand feel moisturizing latex material, it's different from other plastic and silk flowers, more real, bigger and softer than ordinary hydrangea.
Dimension: Total length: 21 inch (53CM), the length of flower head: 4.7 inch (12CM), the diameter of flower head: 7.5 inch (19CM); Each faux hydrangea consisting of 196 pcs small petals and 3pcs green leaves with green stem
Packages: Each package has 5pcs Artificial Hydrangea Head with stems seperately(Vase is not included). The product requires assembly.
The fake Hydrangea Flower bouquets keeps beauty and fresh-looking for a long time.If you want these flowers to look like growing in water, you may put them in a glass vase with water, and water the surface of the flower head to make the Hydrangea looks fresh. Also is the best choice for people who are allergic to pollen.
DIY your own bouquet. You may put Hydrangea with Calla lilies tulips, peonies, roses and some green leaves together, make a beautiful bouquet, it will be a good gift for your mother, daughter friends and everyone you loved.
Hydrangea artificial flowers are ideal for placing in a vase, filling of center pieces or home, wedding decoration. Either use them as the bridal bouquet or put them as the centerpieces on the table. Use your imagination to create a romantic wedding party that belongs to you.
Multi Function: Perfect for wedding centerpieces,reception table decor,wedding arrnagements & bouquets ,everything that you want at your wedding, party, baby shower or home, etc.
Warm Tips: In order to facilitate the transportation, We will separate the flowers, stem, put in same box. After receiving the package, you need to assemble them. Before the installation, please gently shake the hydrangea to let it stretch more naturally. Do not soak in water for a long time, because there are bionic coating on the stem surface.
